In the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of Edron, a group of {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} guards something very valuable. Go down to the main hunting floor (where you reach the Demons), clear the last room and open the box in the corner to receive 5 {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}.
A pair of priestesses guard something very valuable to them.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
to climb back up through the holes when leaving
Floor -4 has 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}: if you're a low level, pass carefully or go with company.
In the same room is the {item:Simon the Beggar's Favorite Staff}, used in another quest.
Follow the Hero Cave path to the main hunting floor, where you reach the {creature:Demon|Demons}.

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the captain at your city's port (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the **Edron** port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

From the port, go **north** to the {wiki:Hero Cave} entrance, north of **Edron**. Watch out for the {creature:Hunter|Hunters} (and {creature:Poacher|Poachers}) at ground level, who guard the entrance.

Go down the first floors. On -1 there are {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}. On -2 there is a {creature:Bonelord}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and Wild Warriors. On -3 there are Demon Skeletons, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks} and Wild Warriors.
Floor -2: Bonelord, Priestesses, Demon Skeletons and Wild Warriors
Floor -3: Demon Skeletons, Monks and Wild Warriors
On -4 there are 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. On -5 there is a {creature:Hero} and {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}.
The Dragons on floor -4 are dangerous for low levels.
On -6 (the main hunting floor) there are {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and many other creatures. Look for the Priestesses' final room.
Floor -6: Priestesses, Demon Skeletons and many other creatures
The final room has 4 {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and a {creature:Stone Golem}. Kill them.
The final room, where Simon the Beggar's staff is also found
The potions are in a {item:Box|box} in the corner of the room. Open it to receive 5 {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}.

To leave, go back the **same way**. Climb the stairs on each floor and use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through, from floor -6 up to ground level. Watch out for the Dragons on floor -4 again.
Outside, go **south** to the city of **Edron**. If you want to leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port ({key:hi} and the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
